Name: 1.6 Slime Hutch (Yellog's Wood Buildings)
Author: morphinpink
Description:
As many of you may be aware, the 1.6 update changed the size of Slime Hutches. I love [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]Yellog's Wood Buildings[/url] and cannot play without this mod so I made an updated version in the 1.6 that matches Yellog's buildings style.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZcLAPDj.png[/img]
[b][i]This is not the full mod! [/i][/b]I've only included the sprites in this download.
[list=1]
[*]Download the actual mod from [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]yellog's own website[/url].
[*]Then replace the slime hutch files with these and that's it, you're good to go.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XaxBwuY.png[/img]﻿

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/2yolI37.png[/img]﻿
Of course, this is an [b]unofficial[/b] update and all credit goes to Yellog for the gorgeous building aesthetic. Hopefully Yellog will update their mods eventually. In the meantime these should blend seamlessly with the rest of your buildings.

Downloads.Description: Replace the Slime Hutch files in Yellog's mod with these. You must download the original mod from Yellog's site first, this download only includes the updated slime hutch made by me.
